title.en: A second robot learns where not to move, never when people are home

goal.en: Another robot in the same home may receive movement, quiet, safe-zone, pet-storage and equipment constraints. The no-movement zone is derived from the schedule and the hallway traffic facet without revealing either. A role that is not in the roles file receives nothing.

note.en: Derive the other-robot view of the example household.
The no-movement zone comes from the household schedule and the observed hallway traffic; the constraint says where, not when the children come home.
A role name that is not in profiles/household/recipient-roles.json has an empty allow-list: the roles file is an allow-list, not a default.

outcome.en: Two robots from different makers can share a kitchen through constraints without sharing the household's facts. Next: 086 reads the travel rules behind these answers.
